# Version requirements

The versions Ipê is built with and requires at runtime, split into two kinds: a **pinned** version is exact — every build uses precisely that release — while a **minimum** is a floor — the oldest release verified to work; anything newer is accepted.

## Pinned exactly

| What | Version |
|------|---------|
| Rust toolchain | `1.98.1` |
| Edition | `2024` |

## Minimum floor — database engines

`Ipe.Db` refuses to connect, at connect time, to an engine below its floor rather than emit SQL the engine may not understand.

| Engine | Minimum version |
|--------|------------------|
| SQLite | `3.35` |
| PostgreSQL | `9.5` |
